addisHighlights.headline: Explore Addis Ababa's Top Attractions
addisHighlights.subheadline: From ancient fossils to vibrant markets, Addis Ababa is a city of contrasts and discoveries. Here are the must-see highlights.

attractions.title: National Museum of Ethiopia
attractions.description: Home to Lucy, the 3.2-million-year-old hominid fossil that revolutionized our understanding of human evolution. Recently renovated in 2025 with improved exhibits and security.

attractions.title: Addis Mercato (Merkato)
attractions.description: Africa's largest open-air market, with over 13,000 vendors selling spices, textiles, coffee, and traditional crafts. A sensory explosion and cultural immersion.

attractions.title: Holy Trinity Cathedral
attractions.description: Architectural masterpiece and final resting place of Emperor Haile Selassie. Features stunning stained glass, intricate carvings, and religious murals.

attractions.title: Entoto Park
attractions.description: Panoramic city views from Addis Ababa's highest point (3,200 meters). Historic Entoto Maryam Church, eucalyptus forests, and the founding location of the city in 1886.

dayTripDestinations.headline: Day Trips from Addis Ababa
dayTripDestinations.subheadline: Escape the city and explore Ethiopia's highlands, monasteries, UNESCO sites, and crater lakes—all within a few hours' drive.

destinations.title: Debre Libanos Monastery
destinations.description: 13th-century monastery perched on a dramatic gorge. Founded by Saint Tekle Haymanot, still an active spiritual center. Spot gelada baboons and enjoy breathtaking views.

destinations.title: Tiya UNESCO World Heritage Site
destinations.description: 32 carved stone stelae dating to the 11th–13th centuries. A mysterious burial complex with enigmatic symbols and decorations. Designated UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1980.

destinations.title: Menagesha Suba Forest
destinations.description: One of Ethiopia's last remaining highland rainforests. Hike through ancient juniper and podocarpus trees, spot endemic birds, and visit cascading waterfalls.

destinations.title: Bishoftu (Debre Zeit) Crater Lakes
destinations.description: Five stunning crater lakes in the Rift Valley. Swim, kayak, or relax at resort facilities. Perfect for families and travelers seeking a leisurely day trip.

practicalInfo.headline: Plan Your Visit to Addis Ababa

columns.title: Visa Requirements
columns.description: Most nationalities require a visa (available on arrival or e-visa). Check requirements before travel. We can assist with visa support letters for confirmed bookings.

columns.title: Best Time to Visit
columns.description: October to March (dry season, mild temperatures 15–25 °C). Peak tourist season is November–February, coinciding with major festivals like Timket (Epiphany) in January.

columns.title: Currency & Payments
columns.description: Ethiopian Birr (ETB). ATMs widely available. Credit cards accepted at major hotels and restaurants. We accept USD, EUR, and ETB for tour payments.

columns.title: Altitude & Health
columns.description: Addis Ababa is at 2,400 meters (7,874 feet). Take it easy on your first day, stay hydrated, and avoid heavy exertion initially. Tap water is not safe to drink (bottled water provided on tours).
